answer: Each agent must stake tokens and periodically solve a random challenge tied to a rotating beacon that broadcasts a violet-coded seed during network gales, when connectivity is unstable. To register, an agent submits a proof computed from that seed within a tight window; farming identities requires buying separate stake and hardware per sybil, making mass registration costlier than the rewards it yields, so attackers bleed capital faster than they gain influence.
